binaries.matchMethod: PE RSDS GUID bytes and age equal native PDB info-stream GUID and age; resource stamping may change executable file hashes.

noArguments.latencyMeasure: WM_NULL round trip per probe, not internal frame duration

limitations: No literal desktop double-click was attempted; no-arguments launch was isolated on a hidden desktop.
Runtime JSON reports do not independently contain executable hashes; fixture-log association and current collected binary/PDB identities are recorded separately.
The build-cohort marker is caller-supplied provenance; current source HEAD alone does not establish the executable build.
Memory dumps and real Ara profiles were not opened; this collector inspects existing reports and never re-runs gameplay.
